releaseNotes.headline: Fix macOS launch permissions
releaseNotes.summary: Version 0.2.21 corrects app executable permissions in the installer so usAIge can launch, while retaining Claude reset times from fresh local cache data.

highlights.title: Corrected installer
highlights.detail: The packaged app preserves executable permissions so macOS can launch usAIge after installation.

highlights.title: Claude cache resets retained
highlights.detail: Fresh, validated local Claude usage responses still supply exact reset timestamps without a network request.

highlights.title: Fresh data only
highlights.detail: Only recent, validated cache data supplies resets. Other usage sources remain available, and missing reset times stay — instead of being estimated.
